title: Coding with OpenCode 2
description: OpenCode 2 on your project with its maker's models (opencode.ai), PyPI, npm and GitHub open for the project's packages and code, the agent's memory of this project kept between sessions; everything else stays closed.

de.title: Programmieren mit OpenCode 2
de.description: OpenCode 2 an Ihrem Projekt mit den Modellen seines Herstellers (opencode.ai), PyPI, npm und GitHub offen für die Pakete und den Code des Projekts, das Gedächtnis des Agenten zu diesem Projekt bleibt zwischen den Sitzungen; alles andere bleibt zu.

notes: The model: OpenCode Zen on opencode.ai (/connect in OpenCode 2 signs in, kept in the start's HOME), or --api-key HOST=NAME with --model PROVIDER/MODEL for another provider.

PyPI, npm and GitHub are open for the project's dependencies; everything else is refused or asked (--ask). Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy. With npm open OpenCode 2 can install the plugins a configuration names; opencode plugin add|update|check still needs --opencode2-enable plugins.
Memory: ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md belongs to this project only and is kept between runs (not with --no-memory); the agent keeps its notes about the project there.

OpenCode 2 asks before what its rules ask before; -D lets it go on without asking. Its update check, model catalog, plugins from npm and web search stay off unless --opencode2-enable names them (updates, models-catalog, plugins, web-search).
OpenCode 2's telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on (Bun's crash reporter and OpenTelemetry pinned off, bun.report refused by the proxy).
OpenCode 2 is not live-tested yet (a start says so); its image first: sandbox-ai build opencode2.
